notes: τοῖς ποσίν is a separate phrase from ἐν Λύστροις: no genitive pronoun stands to take the supplied his, so the article is what his realizes under rule 20's second arm, the dative's case preposition in riding along under rule 21.
χωλός is substantival with no article competing, so the supplied indefinite is a rule 7 helper under rule 51's anarthrous clause.
All three variants here are underdetermined with base readings compatible with the ASV, so no rule 97 note is owed.
